item.title: Keeping tabs on Millwall's loanees
item.description: The majority of Millwall's loanees were in action last weekend. Kamarl Grant played a double-header for Blackpool on Saturday and Tuesday, hitting the post and playing the full game in their 2-0 win over Northampton Town, before he was withdrawn after 74 minutes of their 2-1 home loss against Stockport County in midweek. item.title: Millwall launch 'The Cubhouse'
item.description: Millwall Football Club and the Junior Lions are proud to launch 'The Cubhouse'! A NEW area, dedicated for Junior fans to experience FREE fun, will be open for the first time this Saturday as The Lions take on Sheffield United in the Sky Bet Championship (kick-off 3pm). Located inside Millwall Community Trust's Lions Centre, The Cubhouse - which will be open from 12.30pm before all 3pm kick-offs - is open for both home and away young fans to keep them entertained before the big match. item.title: Lions register record 'new' Den League attendance
item.description: Last weekend's 4-0 win over Charlton Athletic saw a record League attendance at The 'new' Den registered. The crowd of 19,004 also acts as the second-highest figure the new stadium has seen since its opening in 1993; an attendance of 20,093 against Arsenal for an FA Cup tie in 1994 currently stands as the all-time record. item.title: Casper discusses Millwall century
item.description: Casper De Norre reached 100 Millwall appearances last weekend. Bringing up the landmark during the 4-0 Sky Bet Championship thumping of Sheffield United, the Belgian midfielder then sat down with Millwall TV+ earlier this week at Calmont Road to chat about the derby day victory. Click play on the video below to hear more from Casper, including his thoughts on the arrival of Barry Bannan and the upcoming visit of Sheffield United.

item.title: Alex Neil on Barry Bannan arrival
item.description: Alex Neil has spoken to Millwall TV+ following the arrival of Barry Bannan to SE16. Below, hear a pre-match interview with the Head Coach as he talks about his new midfielder, this weekend's visit of Sheffield United and much, much more.

item.title: Millwall to mark Memorial Day this weekend
item.description: Millwall Football Club will host its annual 'Memorial Day' on Saturday as Sheffield United visit The Den in the Sky Bet Championship (kick-off 3pm). Memorial Day sees The Lions remember those loved ones lost by supporters across 2025, by way of a minute's applause before kick-off as the names entered appear on the big screen.
